## Create and switch client organizations

- **What it is:** On Agency, one separate organization per client, free to create, sharing the plan's contacts and numbers.
- **Plan:** Agency.
- **Who can do it:** The owner of the agency organization. Admins and members do not see the action.
- **Where:** The organization switcher, at the top of the sidebar > Create client organization > Create organization
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/client-organizations.md, section "create-a-client-organization". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/client-organizations#create-a-client-organization
